title: StegSeed Witness Bundle
description: A verifiable proof package demonstrating that admissibility held at substantiation time and that evidence obligations were satisfied.

witness_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this witness bundle.

generated_at.description: When the witness bundle was assembled (typically at substantiation).

assurance_level.description: Assurance class for the substantiation proven by this witness bundle.

evidence.description: Evidence artifacts referenced by URI and protected by hashes.

type.description: Category of evidence (inspection_report, measurement_scan, material_cert, photo, video, log, config_snapshot, approval_letter, etc.).

scope.description: Optional scope tag (entity, actor, environment, system_state).

signatures.description: Signatures attesting to admissibility and integrity of the witness bundle and/or evidence.

signer_kind.description: human, ai_entity, system, inspector, fabricator, operator, regulator, physical_device, etc.

signature.description: Detached signature over hash_manifest (or canonicalized witness bundle), encoded as base64/hex.

key_ref.description: Optional reference to public key material or certificate chain.

attestation.description: Optional short claim of what is being attested (e.g., 'admissibility satisfied', 'inspection passed').

context.description: Minimal context needed to re-verify admissibility later.

admissibility_conditions.description: The exact conditions evaluated (StegSeed Conditions DSL nodes) at substantiation time.

environment.description: Key/value tags relevant to jurisdiction, site, runtime, toolchain, etc.

world_state_refs.description: Optional references to snapshots used for evaluation (hash-addressed).

hash_manifest.description: Canonical manifest enumerating what was signed and what hashes protect the bundle and referenced artifacts.

path.description: Logical path within the witness bundle (or referenced artifact URI label).

bundle_hash.description: Optional overall hash of the canonicalized witness bundle, if computed.

notes.description: Optional human notes. Must not be required for verification.
